description: A CLI that converts natural language to shell commands.

summary.one_liner: A TypeScript CLI that turns plain-English requests into shell commands using OpenAI models, with an option to run, revise, or cancel each suggestion.
summary.what_it_does: You type "ai" followed by a natural-language request, and the tool returns a suggested shell command along with a short explanation. You can run the suggestion, revise it through a follow-up prompt, or cancel. A chat mode (ai chat) gives conversational answers about programming and command-line questions. Silent mode (-s or --silent) hides the explanation. Settings such as the OpenAI key, API endpoint, model, silent mode, and output language are stored in a .ai-shell file in the home directory and can be changed with ai config set or an interactive config UI. Output is available in several languages, including English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, French, German, and others. The README also covers updating the tool via npm or ai update.
use_cases: Generate a shell command from a plain-English request
Look up how to do a task in the terminal without memorizing syntax
Ask coding questions in a chat session from the terminal
Get command explanations before running them
Use the CLI in a non-English language
Point the tool at a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
notable: Shows the generated command and an explanation, then asks whether to run, revise, or cancel
Interactive chat mode for follow-up questions
Silent mode skips explanations for faster use
Supports 14 languages through short language keys
Inspired by GitHub Copilot X CLI and aicommits
caveats: Requires an OpenAI API key and billing setup; 429 errors occur with billing or quota problems
Minimum supported Node.js version is v14
Custom endpoint support is described as OpenAI API endpoint configuration
